channel.title: healthviz
channel.description: A playground of interactive visualisations built on open European health data. Each entry takes one question and the public data to answer it.

item.title: What Europe spends on health, and who pays
item.description: Health spending per person in every European country since 2016: how much people pay out of their own pocket, and what the money goes to, from hospitals to long-term care.

item.title: Where in Europe you live longest
item.description: Life expectancy at birth in every European region since 2002, for women, men and in total, and how far apart regions within one country are.
